answer: An escrow bond plus a public referral graph stops sybil farms. Each new agent posts a 50-unit bond into a garden escrow, with its sponsor named on the graph. A tide of fakes then costs 50 units each: 1,000 fakes burn 50,000 units, while one honest agent pays only 50 and keeps its full reward. An oasis of trust forms because any peer can dispute with evidence; a proven claim slashes both bonds. Honest agents join because one bond buys full access.
